The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 天雄 (tiānxióng), flavor acrid, warm. It governs great wind (大風), cold-damp bi (寒濕痹), pain of the joints (歷節痛), contracture and relaxation (拘攣緩急), breaks accumulations and evil-qi (積聚邪氣), metal wounds (金創), strengthens the sinews and bones, and lightens the body...
